concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-development-resources-batch-processing-advanced-sftp-batch-files-batch-request-file-authorisation-request-file-authorisation-for-ach-direct-debit]] — 2019-modified bank-transfer/ACH DD SFTP authorisation-request sub-line schema for amount/exponent, bank account and addresses, with table/example conflicts (2026-09-15 snapshot).
warnings: BankAccount owner-name table says two-letter AA while sample uses Adyen Inc; accepted format is not resolved by this page.
Address prose calls for separate billing and delivery sub-lines, but the sample contains only Billing; do not infer delivery optionality from the sample.
This request schema does not establish ACH shopper consent/mandate or payment outcomes.
